report_coverage.note: the report file is rendered from the public incident record; linked write-ups are pointers

attacker.reason: the rubric labels identity by address-literal presence; realism-gate checks whether the PoC uses that identity to drive the call. The 0.0 is the disagreement rate of a deliberately weak label, not a tool error rate; re-label identity by caller binding before using this field.

fixtures.why: the three rows are private-log inputs and are not part of the public export; the public repository holds only their ids and the expected status

not_claimed: not a measurement of the tool's full rule set: only claim binding is scored here
not truth: the labels say whether the PoC source structurally evidences the claim, not whether the incident happened
the claim source is the public incident record (DeFiHackLabs header), not the full linked write-up
amount claims are not scored: the record states a fiat loss, the PoC asserts token balances
the 3 rejection-row fixtures need private inputs and are not scored from this repository
